# Impact of each contribution (auto-generated by analyse_contrib.py)

Scored on the last 70 % of each stream; the first 30 % was used for threshold tuning. Values are mean±std over seeds (CICIDS2017: 5, IoTID20: 3). Differences are paired by seed: `mean ±95% CI`; `*` = the interval excludes zero. Percent metrics ×100; drop/recovery measured around the authors' hand-marked drifts that fall in the scored part (CICIDS2017 only); thr = flows/second.
